newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber off $10 limit on fund sales, weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber off $10 limit on fund sales, weak cash.

text.p: CME July lumber fell the $10.00 per thousand board feet limit on fund selling with sentiment depressed partly by weakness in the cash market.
Floor sources said ABN-AMRO Chicago Corp was a noted seller.
They noted cash prices were at the lowest levels in around a year with Random Lengths quoting cash spruce at $358 per tbf, down $4 from midweek and $6 under last Friday's level.
July fell the $10 limit to $357.10 with other months off $6.00 to $5.00.
